title: Constant
text: Constant value, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets Sampling interval; {Constant value} sets the constant output value scalar, {Interpret vector parameters as 1-D} treats vectors as 1-D, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type}, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Mode} sets the category of data, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Signedness} sets the signed, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Fraction length} sets the fraction length for fixed-point data type, {Slope} sets the slope for the fixed-point data and {Bias} sets the bias for the fixed-point data type. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Constant value scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Constant value
params.values: Constant output value scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Inherit from ’Constant value’ (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | half | int8 | int16 |...

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Mode
params.values: Category of data to specify Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed point | Enumerated | Bus object | Value type | Expression

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Specify data type override mode for this signal Inherit | Off

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Specify signed or unsigned Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point | Slope and bias

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 0 to 32

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Specify fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | scalar integer

params.name: Slope
params.values: Specify slope for the fixed-point data type 2^0 (default) | positive, real-valued scalar

params.name: Bias
params.values: Specify bias for the fixed-point data type 0 (default) | real-valued scalar
